facts.text: Howard Payne University's Academy of Freedom Museum was dedicated in 1969 to commemorate humanity's search for lasting freedom and host the university's multidisciplinary honors program in civic leadership and public policy.

sources.title: Academy of Freedom | Howard Payne University
sources.quote: Dedicated in 1969, the Academy of Freedom Museum commemorates humanity's search for lasting freedom and hosts the university's multidisciplinary honors program in civic leadership and public policy.

facts.text: Admission to the Guy D. Newman Honors Academy is a highly competitive honor limited to a maximum of 25 students admitted each year.

sources.title: Honors Apply Online | Howard Payne University
sources.quote: Admission to the Academy is a highly competitive honor, with a maximum of 25 students admitted each year.
